# CEUR-WS.org

> > CEUR-WS.org is an open-access digital library for publishing peer-reviewed workshop proceedings with long-term preservation and creative commons licensing.

CEUR-WS.org (CEUR Workshop Proceedings) is a community service for publishing high-quality workshop papers in computer science and related fields. Hosted at RWTH Aachen University and preserved long-term by TIB Hannover, it provides free access to thousands of proceedings volumes across AI, ontologies, and specialized computing domains.

## Key Topics

## Publishing Guidelines & How to Submit

- [Publishing at CEUR-WS.org](https://ceur-ws.org/HOWTOSUBMIT.html): Guide for authors publishing workshop proceedings with CEUR-WS.org
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-XXX - Workshop on Publishing Papers with CEUR-WS YYYY](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-XXX): HTML template and publishing guidelines for CEUR-WS workshop papers
- [CEUR-WS Tools for Workshop Organizers](https://ceur-ws.org/ceurtools): Documentation for CEUR-WS validation tools in Bash, Perl, and Python3

## Policies & Core Values

- [CEUR-WS.org Core Values](https://ceur-ws.org/CEURWS-VALUES.html): CEUR-WS.org core values on open-access scientific publishing and peer review
- [CEUR-WS Policy on AI-Assisting Tools](https://ceur-ws.org/GenAI/Policy.html): CEUR-WS policy on generative AI disclosure and responsible AI usage
- [CEUR-WS Policy on AI-Assisting Tools - Happy Path](https://ceur-ws.org/happypath.html): Happy path guide for workshop organizers on AI-assisting tools policy

## Infrastructure & Preservation

- [CEUR-WS.org: Long-term archival by TIB Hannover](https://ceur-ws.org/CEURWS-TiB.html): Long-term digital preservation of CEUR-WS.org by TIB Hannover
- [ISSN Entry for CEUR Workshop Proceedings](https://ceur-ws.org/issn-1613-0073.html): ISSN registry entry for CEUR Workshop Proceedings serial publication

## Featured Series

- [CEUR-WS.org - AIxIA Series](https://ceur-ws.org/aixia.html): CEUR-WS.org proceedings series for Italian Association for AI (AIxIA)
- [CEUR-WS.org - IAOA Series](https://ceur-ws.org/iaoa.html): CEUR-WS.org open-access proceedings series for ontology workshops

## Recent Workshop Proceedings

- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4185 - Latin American Women in Computing 2025](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4185): LAWCC 2025 workshop proceedings on women in computing in Latin America
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4184 - Zephyr in Science and Education 2025](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4184): Workshop proceedings on Zephyr RTOS for embedded systems education
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4183 - 1st Streaming Continual Learning Bridge at AAAI 2026](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4183): StreamingCL 2026 workshop proceedings on continual learning and LLMs
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4181 - Annual Doctoral Symposium of Computer Science 2025](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4181): Doctoral symposium proceedings on AI, security, and learning analytics
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4179 - CRISTAIN 2025 Workshop Proceedings](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4179): CRISTAIN 2025 workshop proceedings on AI for crime resolution analysis
